notes.title: Patch 1.1.32
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.32

* Fixed text issues on negative map modifiers.
* Added rarity labels for equipment comparisons/crafting.
* When salvaging buildings the cursor will snap to grid.
* If all sides of a replicator are blocked, units will spawn in the nearest open tile.
* Fixed bug where on the crafting screen if you had an equipment selected, and then pressed craft the comparison would still appear.
* Fixed bug where the area beside the "Start Engine" would block cursor interactions.
* When maps fail to generate because they can't place resources, make the map larger as well,
* Make the validation check faster when determining whether or not a map is valid.
* The Massive Reinforcements modifier label now properly says 5 minutes (instead of 10).
* Fix bug where the last slot of your drill modules were not being properly saved when you were in T3.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 out now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This patch has been in the works for quite some time and I am glad to finally release it.

[h1]Version 1.1 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Bosses.
[*] New weapons, buildings and drones.
[*] Slightly reduced the difficulty.
[*] Knowledge is now gained quicker.
[*] Shortened the length of each run.
[/list]

[h2]Drill Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Forge - New Drill module used to spend Forge Cores to increase crafted equipment's power.
[*] New random events that can happen while drilling!
[*] Increased chance of finding higher rarity equipment.
[*] Renamed all gear from old/advanced/expert to now be Mk1/Mk2/Mk3.
[/list]

[h2]In Game Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New level types can now appear, including special boss levels.
[*] Completely new map generation for tunnel maps. No longer linear paths and more balanced difficulty in comparison to open maps.
[*] Reworked awareness system - New visual indicator of progress towards next awareness level. 
[*] 	Enemy waves are now directly tied to awareness and appear each time the bar is filled.
[*] Artifacts - In each level you will find Artifacts randomly scattered throughout, activating them will provide a bonus but cause the swarm to become more aware.
[*] Forge Cores - Randomly spread throughout maps, collect them to upgrade your Drills Forge.
[*] Artifacts and Forge Cores appear white on the minimap.
[*] Burrowers have been removed from normal maps and can only appear as a negative modifier.
[*] New Hunt unit command - Units will automatically explore and clear the map.
[*] Projectiles can no longer go through walls.
[*] Units and buildings will not aggro or target through walls.
[*] Vipers are now ranged.
[*] Blueprints are now obtained 2x faster in the second/third biomes. This should help reduce the grind needed to collect them all.
[*] Death nests spawn more swarm.
[*] Can now give orders to units/drones using the minimap.
[*] Medic units will follow units that are in combat.
[*] Healthbars now appear over selected entities, or press Left-Alt to show for everything.
[*] Added display showing average resources gained per second.
[*] Many bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]UI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completely redesigned the UI in the Drill view.
[*] New Drill log that captures the history of your current run.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.67
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.67

Drill UI Improvements
[list]
[*] Added tabs onto the right side UI to contain crafting, equipment lists and augments.
[*] Hovering over equipment now shows the stats and gives comparisons.
[*] When you have no valid starting units, the game will notify you immediately.
[/list]

Gameplay Changes
[list]
[*] You can now queue orders for your units.
[*] Added "Patrol" unit command.
[*] Slightly improved unit movement to not get stuck when moving in a giant ball.
[*] Added Supply Placement Helper - When placing supply towers the game will find the closest position that keeps the supply chain going. This will allow you to rapidly place supply towers and never accidentally place them out of supply range.
[*] Holding ctrl will cancel supply placement helper and allow you to place anywhere, you can also disable it in the game options.
[*] New supply overlay colour for supply towers that are not yet built.
[*] Each time a unit or turret attacks their icon on the minimap will flash yellow.
[*] Ctrl Clicking units/buildings will now select all of the same type.
[*] Ctrl Shift Clicking and pressing a control group will add those to that group.
[/list]

Don't forget to join the discord to discuss the game, provide feedback, or give suggestions!
[url=https://discord.gg/t945m4jmsk]Join Discord[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.54
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.0.54[/h1]
[h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Remade the Drill UI to make it simpler to use, faster to compare and require less clicks to do what you want to do.
[*]Crafting core equipment (Miner & Generator) now have separate crafting buttons.
[*]Crafting all supports is 1 part cheaper, while crafting equipment has been increased by 1.
[*]Crafting drone equipment now costs 5, while supports cost 3. (Great deal!)
[*]Added lock cursor to window setting.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the run difficulty would not be what you chose.
[*]Heavy Projectiles / Instant Reload augments now properly only apply to units.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.33

Patch 1.0.33

notes.title: Deep Among the Swarm - Out Now!
notes.notes:
The day has finally arrived. [b]Deep Among the Swarm (DATS) is officially available on Steam![/b] I have solo developed this game for the past 3 years and am extremely excited for everyone to get to play it.

Big shoutout to all the playtesters that helped provide feedback, report bugs and have just been a blast to interact with.

If you enjoy the game, I’d love it if you could leave a review. This really helps DATS gain traction on Steam and helps provide feedback.

Join the community: [url=https://discord.gg/t945m4jmsk]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Demo v0.1.32 patch notes
notes.notes:
Demo v0.1.32 patch notes


[list]
[*] New blueprint unlocking system, unlock upgrades by finding blueprints in missions
[*] 2 new Drill Modules (Forge and Core).
[*] Each module on your Drill will be upgradeable giving bonuses.
[*] The new forge module will be focused around improving your ability to craft upgrades, increasing their power and will be where you view/scrap your unused upgrades.
[*] Upgrades (Weapons, armour, turrets etc) will now have a tier associated with them, which can only be crafted once your forge has been upgraded to that tier.
[*] As upgrades get higher tier, they are more powerful but cost more.
[*] Can now upgrade miners and generators
[*] A bunch of new support upgrades for your units and turrets
[*] Unlockable bonuses that are randomly rolled on your upgrades
[*] Plus a bunch of other changes
[/list]

Don't forget to join the discord to discuss the game, provide feedback, or give suggestions!

notes.title: Demo v0.1.27 patch notes
notes.notes:
Demo v0.1.27 patch notes

[list]
[*]Meta Progression revamped, Total of 69 meta upgrades available now.
[*]Drill now starts with 250 maximum radium storage, must be upgraded to get more
[*]Loot crates are now given instead of upgrades when destroying Wrecks / enemy bases. Loot crates are opened after the level and give you a choice between multiple upgrades.
[*]Melee units now cost 0 copper, and your initial starting unit is melee
[*]New Melee weapon sword does aoe damage
[*]Unit armour / head colours can be changed between levels
[*]Difficulty heavily changed, Near impossible to clear the full levels at the start until you have meta progression upgrades
[*]Tons of other minor changes
[/list]

Don't forget to join the discord to discuss the game, provide feedback or suggestions!

notes.title: Demo v0.1.25 patch notes
notes.notes:
Demo v0.1.25 patch notes

[list]
[*] Keybindings can now be changed!
[*] Mine production now increases speed by 20% instead of +1 resource gained
[*] Reload time and Spread now properly show as Green when the value is negative
[*] Added new setting for camera speed which affects speed when mousing at the border, or using the arrow keys
[*] Unit names should always be unique now
[*] Added another tick mark at the top to identify the minimum amount of radium required to begin fueling
[*] Added some special events that can happen, only a few now but the infrastructure is there for more
[*] Added enemy turrets at spawners and hives
[*] Added a new short ranged enemy after beating the first few missions
[*] Units / Turrets can now be ordered to attack a specific enemy by right-click/attack-move on them
[*] Game now properly pauses when on victory or defeat screen
[*] Minor text changes in a few places
[*] The first mission will automatically start after launching as you don't have any upgrades to use anyways. (Unless you were cheesing it)
[*] Difficulty formula slightly changed, ideally around the same difficulty.
[/list]

Don't forget to join the discord to discuss the game, provide feedback or suggestions!
